Open competition 

 

 

The CSC Data Processors Re-engineering Service aims at the implementation of a new Earth Observation Processor Framework (EOPF) and the re-engineering of the data processors currently used to operationally generate the Copernicus Sentinel-1/2/3(land) Level-0, Level-1, Level-2 data with the aim to harmonise and modernise the operational processing framework, to benefit from the capabilities of cloud-based environments such as the elasticity of computing resources and to efficiently support both the systematic production operations as well as the needs of a more flexible on-demand production context. 

 

CS GROUP has been selected by ESA as Prime Contractor for the Sentinels Data Processors Re-engineering Service. As part of this Service, CS GROUP will procure the implementation of the Sentinels processors re-engineering via open competitive tenders according to the ESA Best Practices procedure. 

Three open competitive tenders have already been issued: 

The first one on the 03/02/2023, covering the re-engineering of the Level -1 and Level-2 data processors for Sentinel-2 and the re-engineering of the Level-1 and Level-2 data processors for Sentinel-3 OLCI, SLSTR and Synergy. 

A second one on the 07/04/2023, covering the re-engineering of the Sentinel-1/2/3 Level-0 data processors 

A third one on the 01/06/2023, covering the re-engineering of the Level –1 and Level –2 data processors for Sentinel 1 

 

The fourth and last open competitive tender covering the following activities is planned to be published at the beginning of August 2023:
